description: Universal Teams ASR artifacts for Chilean/neutral Spanish meetings. Framework-owned: overwritten on every upgrade. Project-specific vocabulary belongs in the domain overlay, never here.

confidenceLevels.media: Context-dependent. Lint only; requires human confirmation.
confidenceLevels.baja: Speculative or semantically lossy. Lint only; never auto-applied.
